text: {"lessons":["Selling a stock at a gain can feel rewarding, but I should avoid taking profits simply to lock in a win; weigh the remaining upside and risks against my plan.","After buying Stock E at 128.17, it rose substantially before I sold at 155.20. I should let a sound position run when its outlook supports it, rather than exiting just because the gain feels worth securing.","Selling Stock A at a large loss was painful, but holding on to avoid admitting a mistake would not have been a reason to keep it. Reassess every position on its current merits, not its average cost."]}
